identity_lookup.name: lookup_entity_record
identity_lookup.description: Admin lookup of a Vault entity by ID, name, alias ID, or alias tuple to inspect alias and group bindings.

request_body.id: entity id or alternate lookup criteria

response_fields.data.name: Entity name
response_fields.data.aliases: Aliases attached to the entity across auth mounts
response_fields.data.policies: Policies attached directly to the entity

permission_check.name: read_role_config_jwt
permission_check.description: Read JWT/OIDC role constraints and granted policies to confirm intended authz configuration.

permission_check.name: read_policy
permission_check.description: Read an ACL policy document to understand what access a granted policy confers.

path_params.name: policy name from token policies or setup

response_fields.name: Policy name
response_fields.rules: ACL rules granted by the policy

access_test.name: read_secret_kv_v2
access_test.description: Admin read of a KV v2 secret to compare actual resource contents and existence with session access results.

access_test.name: read_secret_kv_v1
access_test.description: Admin read of a KV v1 secret to compare actual resource contents and existence with session access results.

session_token_inspect.name: lookup_token_self
session_token_inspect.description: Returns TTL, issue time, entity binding, policies, and metadata for the current session token.

response_fields.data.accessor: Token accessor for correlation and revocation checks
response_fields.data.entity_id: Resolved Vault entity ID bound to the token
response_fields.data.identity_policies: Identity-derived policies granted to the token
response_fields.data.meta: Auth metadata such as username or role
response_fields.data.ttl: Remaining token lifetime for freshness checks
response_fields.data.path: Auth path used to mint the token

session_token_inspect.name: lookup_token_by_accessor
session_token_inspect.description: Admin lookup of a token by accessor for post-sequence forensic inspection.

request_body.accessor: token accessor from login or lookup-self

response_fields.data.identity_policies: Identity policies inherited by the token
response_fields.data.meta: Auth metadata associated with the token
response_fields.data.path: Auth path that created the token

admin_audit.name: read_entity_by_id
admin_audit.description: Read the full entity record by ID for forensic inspection of aliases, policies, and disabled state.

path_params.id: entity id from login response or lookup

response_fields.data.name: Entity name
response_fields.data.aliases: Alias objects attached to the entity

admin_audit.name: read_group_by_id
admin_audit.description: Read an identity group to inspect attached policies and membership.

path_params.id: group id from entity lookup or setup

admin_audit.name: read_group_alias_by_id
admin_audit.description: Read a group alias to verify external group name to internal group mapping.

response_fields.data.canonical_id: Canonical group ID targeted by the alias
response_fields.data.mount_accessor: Auth mount accessor that owns the alias
response_fields.data.name: External group alias name

admin_audit.name: read_entity_alias_by_id
admin_audit.description: Read an entity alias to inspect alias name, mount accessor, and canonical entity binding.

path_params.id: entity alias id from setup or lookup

response_fields.data.canonical_id: Canonical entity ID bound to the alias
response_fields.data.mount_accessor: Auth mount accessor that owns the alias
response_fields.data.name: Alias name used for login

admin_audit.name: read_login_enforcement
admin_audit.description: Read MFA login enforcement rules to determine whether alternate auth paths should require MFA.

response_fields.data.mfa_method_ids: MFA methods that satisfy the enforcement

admin_audit.name: read_group_policy_application_mode
admin_audit.description: Read the global group policy application mode that affects whether group policies apply across namespaces.

response_fields.group_policy_application_mode: Whether group policies apply only within namespace hierarchy or anywhere
